plugin_structure.note: oh-my-agents is a Claude Code plugin, not a standard layered application. The directories below describe plugin components, not the target project's architecture layers.

target_layer_model.note: The layer model that oh-my-agents enforces on target projects via arch-check.sh and /arch-guard.

_config_note: These thresholds intentionally diverge from templates/harness-config.json (file_size_limit 300, nested_claude_md_threshold 5). This repo is a markdown/shell PLUGIN (SKILL.md is separately capped at 400 by anti-bloat rule skill-line-cap), so file_size_limit is generous (800); nested_claude_md_threshold is stricter (3) because the plugin is small and densely modular. The template ships the OpenAI source-project defaults for NEW projects. providers_path is null because this plugin has no Providers interface to enforce on itself.
